payRules.title: Pay rule formulas
payRules.subtitle: How each pay component is calculated — review, switch on or off, and add formulas
payRules.priorityHint: Higher wins when multiple rules apply
payRules.descriptionHint: Optional note so this rule can be recognised without reading the formula
payRules.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Employee social security contribution, capped at the yearly ceiling
payRules.testedWith: Tested with sample values: grossSalary 5000, baseSalary 5000, workDays 22, OT_HOURS 10, OT_RATE 1.5.
payRules.syntaxHelp: Reference values and call functions with # — e.g. #grossSalary or #pct(#grossSalary, 6.2). Standard operators + - * / %, comparisons and ? : work too.
payRules.insertHint: Click any item to insert it at the cursor.
payRules.dynamicHint: Pay-component codes are also available as variables — e.g. #BASIC, #OT, #OT_RATE, #TAX_PIT, and #YTD_ year-to-date totals.
payRules.noRulesComputed: No rules — this component is calculated by the payroll engine itself (e.g. salary from compensation, income tax from brackets).
